figurative_meaning_en: nursing infant or very young child
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো গোড়িমোয়ালা ছেলে, এখনো দুধ খায়।
এই কাজটা গোড়িমোয়ালা ছেলের পক্ষে উপযুক্ত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is just a diaper-wearing boy, still nursing on milk.
This task is not suitable for a nursing infant.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on early childhood and dependency.
